source_text: Sudanese surveys, such as those from the Population Council, further reveal that perceived fidelity benefits stem from perceived social signaling—FGM as a marker of conformity—rather than physiological deterrence, with abandonment rates rising in communities without such rituals yet maintaining traditional values.
